correctness.rationale: For every field, the universal exterior-square Lie bracket forces any endomorphism to act as (T,phi; exterior-square(T)) on V plus wedge-square(V). Recomputing its square gives T^2=T and phi T+P phi=phi. For T a projection with V=U plus W, the wedge decomposition makes phi|U land in U wedge W plus wedge-square W and phi|W land in wedge-square U. Shear conjugacy removes exactly these phi coordinates. All normal forms have ranks r+binomial(r,2), uniquely indexed by generator-rank r; counting image subspaces, complements and shears gives exponent r(n-r)(n+2r)/2. Exhaustive direct full-matrix checks over (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2) reproduce every rank coefficient (1,12,1), (1,36,1), and (1,224,896,1) and return VERIFY_OK. Boundary r=0,n and characteristic two are covered by the same proof; finite checks are ancillary.

value.rationale: The count of splittings/retractions is a natural structural invariant of free nilpotent Lie algebras, with direct relation to split quotients and images isomorphic to smaller free algebras. A single theorem classifies the complete automorphism orbit space for every n and every field and gives every finite-field rank multiplicity, with triangular rank support and a nontrivial q-exponent driven by central shear fibers. It is an all-dimension exact invariant rather than a small arbitrary finite computation; the result does not rely on unsupported downstream applications.
